roots.title: Quadratic Optimization
roots.top_down_role: Adaptive-depth structural navigation for Quadratic Optimization; formal statements are stored in a later sidecar layer.

children.title: Convex QP Structural Taxonomy
children.top_down_role: Structural organization of convex quadratic programs with affine constraints, including representations, geometry, certificates, computational regimes, and solver-facing interfaces.

children.title: Convex QP Optimality-Duality-Sensitivity Theory
children.top_down_role: Structural navigation for convex quadratic programs with affine constraints, emphasizing optimality systems, duality, certificates, parametric geometry, sensitivity, and their computational interpretations.

children.title: Active-Set-Interior-Point Algorithm Synthesis
children.top_down_role: Algorithms for linearly constrained quadratic programs organized around working-face methods and barrier-path methods, including their shared computational kernels, guarantees, implementation regimes, and failure boundaries.

children.title: First-Order QP Solver Synthesis
children.top_down_role: Convex quadratic programming viewed through first-order methods, operator splittings, residual and infeasibility certificates, convergence regimes, and large-scale solver architecture.

children.title: Convex QP Model Templates
children.top_down_role: Navigation for recognizing, organizing, transforming, and deploying convex quadratic models with affine constraints; general convex analysis, nonconvex quadratic optimization, and detailed solver algorithms remain outside this chapter.

children.title: Quadratically Constrained Optimization
children.top_down_role: Continuous real and complex quadratic optimization with quadratic constraints, emphasizing structural classification, optimality theory, hidden convexity, relaxations, certificates, recovery, and QCQP-specific computational interfaces.

children.title: Continuous Global Indefinite Quadratic Programming
children.top_down_role: Continuous quadratic optimization with nonconvex objective curvature, globally valid relaxations and certificates, deterministic global solution families, and continuous relaxation bridges to discrete quadratic models.

children.title: Quadratic Structures in Mixed-Integer Models
children.top_down_role: Mixed-integer models whose objectives, constraints, reformulations, relaxations, or global bounds exploit quadratic structure; general MINLP algorithms and continuous quadratic optimization remain external dependencies.

children.title: Quadratic Relaxation-Strengthening Hierarchy
children.top_down_role: Convex relaxations, strengthening mechanisms, bound comparisons, exactness regimes, and computational interfaces for continuous, binary, and mixed-integer quadratic models.

children.title: Quadratic Subproblem Solver Architecture
children.top_down_role: Quadratic models arising inside continuous optimization methods, their canonical geometries and certificates, trust-region and bound-constrained solution families, and the direct or iterative linear algebra used to solve their optimality systems.
